name: neonCyber
title: Neon Cyber
description: High-octane cyberpunk atmosphere with electric cyan, searing magenta laser glows, dark obsidian void, and instant snap velocity.
do: Layer vivid emissive cyan and magenta against pitch black voids
Use snappy keyframe acceleration with optical bloom on impacts
Incorporate digital glitch transitions and wireframe grid overlays
dont: Do not use muted earth tones, pastel washes, or sepia grades
Avoid sluggish, floating easing curves with no punch
Never leave neon text without emissive outer glow falloff
